name: Table Money
tagline: Chases down the invoices and refunds you never closed out
description: You answer a few questions once, then it looks back over a window you choose, one month, two or three, for work that was billed to nobody, subscriptions still quietly charging, and cash somebody owes you. Findings land in a table with a follow-up note drafted for each, and nothing leaves your outbox unapproved.
author: Andrew51786
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
